## Highlights
### New
- Support translated Chrome Web Store actions
### Improved
- Format software update release notes as structured Markdown - Automate the public Crest roadmap sync - Improve Crest browser experience - Preserve user-adjusted quick window geometry
### Fixed
- Fix WebExtension window focus lifecycle - Fix SSO window lifecycle and permission defaults - Harden browser imports - Preserve locked sidebar presentation
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
